files.description: Parcel price table (120 rows, sorted by weight_kg, each weight once): weight_kg (two decimals, from 0.40 to 54.05, never a whole number), zones (whole number 1-5), fee (two decimals; about 4% empty).

task_text: For the parcels weighing from 20 kg up to 40 kg, count the price rows for each zones value. `result` should be a Series of counts indexed by zones, ordered by zones from 1 to 5.
intended_computation: Among the 46 rows with 20 <= weight_kg <= 40, the number of rows per zones value (1-5), ascending by zones.

acceptable_variants.notes: a zones value with no row may be omitted or shown as 0.

predicted_direction.reason: table[20:40] on the float weight index selected 20-40 kg by label on 2.x; on 3.x it takes rows 20-39 by position, so the counts describe other parcels.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row I02; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
